# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 61 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 61

**1** Jesus said: "Two will rest on a bed; one will die, one will live." Salome said: "Who are you, sir? You have reclined on my couch as if from someone and have eaten from my table." Jesus said to her: "I am he who comes from the one who is whole. I was given from the things of my Father." [Salome said:] "I am your disciple." [Jesus said:] "Therefore I say: when a person is whole, he will be filled with light; but when he is divided, he will be filled with darkness."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Sir" rather than "man" — respectful address by Salome
- The brackets mark editorial attribution of the incomplete dialogue
- "From the one who is whole" — the Father as source of wholeness
- "When a person is whole / divided" — the moral-anthropological conclusion
